ICC Tournaments & Format Types

tournaments + tournament_types + player_tournaments

Manage primary tournaments (TID, Tname, Tduration), composite tournament_types (TID, Ttype), and tournament rosters player_tournaments (PID, TID).

Fixtures, Results & Match Teams

matches + match_teams + player_matches

Protected by trigger trg_matches_before_insert (TotalRuns ≥ 0). Manages match_teams(MID, TeamName) and player_matches(PID, MID).

ICC Registered Players & Format Rankings

players + player_formats

Protected by trigger trg_players_before_insert (Salary DECIMAL(12,2) ≥ 0). Links to player_formats, player_tournaments, and player_matches.

Local MySQL Connection Guide

  1. Download the full-stack project archive (icc_cricket_mysql_fullstack.zip) or copy the live SQL script on the right.
  2. Import into your local MySQL server:
    mysql -u root -p < database/icc_schema.sql
  3. Start the Express + mysql2 server:
    npm install && npm start
  4. Click "Configure Local MySQL API" below to connect this UI directly to http://localhost:3000/api.
